title: EvoX: Rethinking the Agent Harness as a Runtime Policy
abstract: arXiv:2611.15006v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly interact with tools and environments, yet plausible model decisions do not always translate into successful execution due to tool-call mismatches, interrupted workflows, and unsupported completion claims. We present EvoX, a Rust-based, multi-model agent runtime guided by The Second Policy, which views the harness as an Operational Policy complementing the foundation model's Semantic Policy. EvoX combines model-facing guidance with deterministic runtime control through three complementary mechanisms: Action Realization, Execution Continuity, and Outcome Grounding. translated_title: EvoX：将智能体执行框架重新构想为运行时策略
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地与工具和环境进行交互，然而由于工具调用不匹配、工作流中断以及缺乏依据的完成声明，看似合理的模型决策并不总能转化为成功的执行。我们提出了 EvoX，一个基于 Rust 的多模型智能体运行时，由“第二策略”理念指导，该理念将执行框架视为一种操作策略，与基础模型的语义策略相辅相成。EvoX 通过三个互补机制——动作实现、执行连续性和结果锚定——将面向模型的引导与确定性的运行时控制相结合。为了在不抑制执行框架原生行为的情况下对其进行评估，我们引入了 Contrast，一个受控且可审计的评估框架，集成了显式的公平性约束、绑定提供商的请求验证以及基于证据的裁定机制。在五个基准测试、六个基础模型和六个智能体执行框架的评估中，EvoX 取得了最高的（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: EvoX 将智能体执行框架重新定义为与基础模型语义策略互补的运行时策略（“第二策略”），通过动作实现、执行连续性和结果锚定三大机制将模型决策与确定性运行时控制相结合，显著提升智能体任务执行效果。
en_tdlr: EvoX reconceives the agent harness as a runtime policy (The Second Policy) complementing the foundation model's semantic policy, combining model-facing guidance with deterministic runtime control through Action Realization, Execution Continuity, and Outcome Grounding to achieve superior agent execution performance.
